answer: In this agent economy each identity must lock a time-bonded stake that starts at the nadir of influence for brand-new accounts and climbs only after many epochs of continuous presence, reaching a summit of quadratic voting weight. Parallel sybil masks therefore each pay the full bond and the multi-epoch wait; the old hash-only admission model is now a relic that no longer lets an attacker spin unlimited cheap copies. One honest long-lived account outvotes a swarm of fresh clones.
